distribution.usage: Install or recover an offline Morphbench Application update. Stop the server first.
distribution.target: Installation folder; defaults to the folder containing update.py.
distribution.package: Complete Application ZIP to verify and install.
distribution.recover: Recover an interrupted update before starting Morphbench.
distribution.check: Validate the archive and installation without replacing application files.
distribution.unsafePath: Unsafe path, link or reparse point; no update is allowed.
distribution.applicationFile: The Application package contains a forbidden file or native/archive content.
distribution.changedFile: An inventoried file is missing or has changed. Restore it before updating.
distribution.runtimeMissing: Install the required Morphbench Runtime in this folder first.
distribution.runtimeMismatch: This Application requires a different Runtime. No files were replaced.
distribution.interpreterMismatch: Start the packaged application with its bundled python/python.exe.
distribution.busy: Morphbench or another updater is running. Stop it before updating.
distribution.recoveryRequired: An update is unfinished. Run update.py --recover before starting Morphbench.
distribution.recoveryInvalid: The recovery journal or backup is damaged. Keep the backup for manual recovery.
distribution.archive: Invalid, oversized or unsupported Application ZIP.
distribution.userCollision: A new application path is occupied by a user file. Move it aside before updating.
distribution.notInstallation: The target must be an existing installation folder.
distribution.immutableRuntime: A Runtime identifier cannot be reused with different contents.
distribution.runtimeJunk: The Runtime seed contains development files or generated caches.
distribution.layoutMismatch: Layout migration requires a new folder; preserve the current installation and copy settings and plugins explicitly.
